title: A PRAYER FOR
ABUNDANT LIFE
end: The Healing Balm — receive God's healing peace
stock_queries: tranquil turquoise living waters flowing gently
warm golden sanctuary light beams dust particles
white dove flying over peaceful horizon
soft morning mist over calm forest lake
glowing embers in quiet prayer room

scenes.a: The shadow of uncertainty currently hanging over your quiet bedroom is meeting its match right now.
With long life will I satisfy him, and show him my salvation.
Father, we hold onto this sacred promise of fullness for every weary soul listening today.
May the weight of pain dissolve as you rest in the depth of His infinite care.
Let your heart be anchored in the salvation only He provides through the passing storms.
We pray that you feel His presence restoring your spirit, blessing your path, and calming everything.
